caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular patchwork quilt composed of nine roughly square fabric pieces arranged in a 3x3 grid. The top row consists of a large blue square with visible quilting lines and two smaller squares on the right, one with a red and black plaid pattern and the other with a light background and small red floral designs. The middle row features, from left to right, a light square with vertical wavy lines, a red and black plaid square, and a blue square similar in color and texture to the square in the top left. The bottom row includes a larger red and black plaid square on the left, a light square with vertical wavy lines in the center, and another blue square on the right. The overall composition contrasts the solid blue areas with patterned squares in shades of red, black, and off-white. The background of the image is an unadorned, light tan or cream-colored paper.
title: Quilt Square
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
